simple.meaning: שַׁיִת (shayith) is a Hebrew word meaning “scrub or trash , i.e. wild growth of weeds or briers (as if put on the field).” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: שַׁיִת (H7898) appears 7 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Isaiah 5:6, with occurrences in Isaiah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שַׁיִת (H7898) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in שַׁיִת (H7898) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: שַׁיִת (shayith) / H7898 is traced through Isaiah 5:6, Isaiah 7:23, Isaiah 7:24, Isaiah 7:25 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

firstOccurrence.englishText: I will lay it a wasteland.

majorEvents.evidenceText: People will go there with arrows and with bow, because all the land will be briers and thorns.

timeline.evidenceText: I will lay it a wasteland.

It will happen in that day that every place where there were a thousand vines at a thousand silver shekels,† A shekel is about 10 grams or about 0.35 ounces, so 1000 shekels is about 10 kilograms or 22 pounds. shall be for briers and thorns.
People will go there with arrows and with bow, because all the land will be briers and thorns.
All the hills that were cultivated with the hoe, you shall not come there for fear of briers and thorns; but it shall be for the sending out of oxen, and for sheep to tread on.”
Therefore the Lord will not rejoice over their young men,
The light of Israel will be for a fire, and his Holy One for a flame; and it will burn and devour his thorns and his briers in one day.
Wrath is not in me, but if I should find briers and thorns, I would do battle! I would march on them and I would burn them together.
